versions.changelog:
Initial release of xiaohongshu-note-audit

- Audits social content-marketing notes for policy compliance and shadowban/throttling risk.
- Scans for banned words, superlative/absolute-claim (极限词) violations, and sensitive content.
- Flags risks and returns actionable, compliant rewrite suggestions.
- Designed for pre-post review of social notes to avoid takedown or account penalties.
- Requires API key from wsdsocial.com for access.
